##### Project general facts

Damac Hills - Lilac is a mid-rise residential tower inspired by the lilac flower and its symbolism of renewal and vitality. Flowing contours and soft curves shape a graceful silhouette, while sweeping balconies and picture windows frame views of the gardens, golf course and parkland. The residences range from studios and one-bedroom apartments to two- and three-bedroom townhouses with en-suite bedrooms and private al fresco spaces.

Residents enjoy a pool with a reflective edge and private cabanas, the Serenity Deck, the Hammock Grove and the Garden Gym. The Bloom Club lounge and an indoor cinema host social gatherings, while the Flower Room and Fragrance Lab offer workshops and private events. Landscaped spaces include a Secret Garden with fire features, Reading and Scent Gardens, an illuminated Butterfly Trail, a BBQ kitchen and a children's play area.

The interiors feature premium finishes and carefully considered details that balance style, comfort and functionality. Layouts make the most of space and natural light, giving the apartments a bright, efficient character and the townhouses room for family living and entertaining. Homes are delivered unfurnished, leaving owners free to personalise the interiors.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Hills is an established golf community in Dubailand, arranged around the Trump International Golf Club Dubai and landscaped parks. It offers easy road access to Dubai Hills Estate, Mall of the Emirates, Global Village and Downtown Dubai, as well as to Dubai International and Al Maktoum International airports.

The community provides Carrefour and Spinneys supermarkets, cafés, pharmacies, a Saudi German Clinic facility and Jebel Ali International School. Leisure options include the Malibu Bay wave pool, an ice rink, horse stables, a skate park, padel and tennis courts and jogging tracks, while Al Qudra Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents to the rest of Dubai.

DAMAC Hills is a freehold community open to international buyers. Golf-course surroundings, family-oriented amenities and a broad mix of property types attract long-term tenants and owner-occupiers, making it one of Dubai's sought-after residential addresses for investment.
